config.scope: development; no unseen-test or deployment-risk guarantee

construction.proposal_choice: first valid in seeded order, before scoring
construction.failure_action: record UNREALIZABLE; no new seed, parent or policy

config.regime_isolation: clean by split shared; head/scaler/increment/calibration fitted separately; no target-family or F0 use in source-only fitting or calibration

data_support.entity_unit: one injected target per attempt; tracker fragmentation does not add entities
data_support.gate_meaning: minimum prototype support, not statistical identifiability or sample-size theorem

calibration.objective: maximize corresponding correct class decision within budget
calibration.no_false_calibration_labels: disable accept branch and mark insufficient calibration

coefficient_interval.method: parent pairs bootstrap, fixed original nonempty family/k cells
coefficient_interval.interpretation: conditional stability interval, not full-model 95-percent coverage guarantee

main_retention.never_adopted_weight: parent/epoch equal over all primary-true epochs
main_retention.delay_weight: parent/epoch equal over shared ever-adopted primary-true epochs
main_retention.delay_origin: first legal primary-true query in the common epoch

config.missing_coverage: record untested/not calibrated; never count absent samples as successes

binding.echo_supervision: empty; old clean rows and Z remain the normal training source
